players.product: optical components for transceivers & CPO (FAU, lens assemblies, isolators)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record, online call; board secretary and deputy general manager Chen Kairong): from the information the company has, the production ramp pace of CPO / NPO has not changed noticeably recently; its FAU and ELS products for the CPO route have a good base in performance, yield and delivery and output will keep rising with customer demand, while its NPO-related products are at the sample stage. Next year's passive-device capacity expansion will cover both pluggable optical modules and CPO / NPO, both with strong demand support. The improved supply of key bottleneck materials for active devices since the end of Q2 is expected to show in results gradually in Q3 and Q4; passive-device demand keeps rising fast. The company would not forecast H2 margins.
